data.title: A bee at the open door
data.goal: A bee at the open door

memoryNodes.cue: A preserved wing can be examined.
A larva appears in one cell.

data.situation:
The door stood open to a bed of plants beginning to blossom. A bee landed on a flower, carrying pollen between the flowers it visited. Ruth explained how bees can pollinate flowers. A display by the door showed an insect with six legs and a damaged wing; it was a preserved specimen, not the bee outside. Next to it was a photograph of a colony inside a hive, with a close-up of a larva in one cell. Maya stepped back so the living bee could leave. Maya: Shall I shut the door?
Ruth: Give the bee room to go out first.
Jo: Is this larva already an adult insect?
Ruth: No. The photograph shows an earlier stage of its life.
They waited until the bee lifted from the flower.

readingBlocks.en: The door stood open to a bed of plants beginning to blossom. A bee landed on a flower, carrying pollen between the flowers it visited. Ruth explained how bees can pollinate flowers. A display by the door showed an insect with six legs and a damaged wing; it was a preserved specimen, not the bee outside. Next to it was a photograph of a colony inside a hive, with a close-up of a larva in one cell. Maya stepped back so the living bee could leave.
readingBlocks.zh: 门开向一畦刚开始开花的植物。蜜蜂落在花上，在来访的花之间携带花粉。露丝解释蜜蜂如何授粉。门边展台有一只六条腿、翅膀受损的昆虫，是保存标本，不是外面的蜜蜂。旁边是蜂巢群体照片和一个巢室内幼虫的特写。玛雅退开，让活蜜蜂飞出去。

readingBlocks.en:
Maya: Shall I shut the door?
Ruth: Give the bee room to go out first.
Jo: Is this larva already an adult insect?
Ruth: No. The photograph shows an earlier stage of its life.
They waited until the bee lifted from the flower.
readingBlocks.zh:
玛雅：要关门吗？
露丝：先留空间让蜜蜂出去。
乔：这条幼虫已是成虫吗？
露丝：不是。照片展示生命中较早阶段。
她们等蜜蜂从花上飞起。

glossary.note: 此处动词，名词花朵义未计。
glossary.example: The plants had begun to blossom.

glossary.note: bee 单数，bees 复数，一单位。
glossary.example: A bee landed on the flower.

externalEvidence.definition: any of numerous hairy-bodied insects including social and solitary species

glossary.zh: 花朵产生并可参与植物繁殖的花粉
glossary.note: 通常不可数；花粉与花蜜不同。
glossary.example: The bee carried pollen between flowers.

externalEvidence.definition: the fine spores that contain male gametes and that are borne by an anther in a flowering plant

glossary.note: 原资料拼作pollenate，教学采用词典词形pollinate；原记录不改。

glossary.zh: 通常有六条腿、身体分三部分的昆虫
glossary.example: The display showed an insect with six legs.
glossary.exampleZh: 展台展示一只六条腿的昆虫。

glossary.zh: 鸟或昆虫等用于飞行的翅膀
glossary.note: wing 名词；建筑侧翼未计。
glossary.example: One wing of the specimen was damaged.

externalEvidence.definition: a movable organ for flying (one of a pair)

glossary.note: 本例群居动物，不是殖民地。
glossary.example: The photograph showed a colony inside a hive.
glossary.exampleZh: 照片展示蜂巢里的群体。

externalEvidence.definition: a group of organisms of the same type living or growing together

glossary.note: larva 单数，larvae 复数；与lava熔岩区分。
glossary.example: A larva lay in one cell.
glossary.exampleZh: 一条幼虫在一个巢室里。

externalEvidence.definition: the immature free-living form of most invertebrates and amphibians and fish which at hatching from the egg is fundamentally unlike its parent and must metamorphose
